reason_for_change: system_prompt embeds {{ domain_policy }} and is re-sent every turn (~28.5 turns/task in static Arm A). The full policy is long with much irrelevant content; a concise summary that preserves all rules actually exercised by supported actions (returns/exchanges/modifies/cancels + auth) reduces input tokens on every turn, compounding across turns to lower mean cost per task while keeping the decision-relevant constraints intact to hold success.
